component.name: YouTube Chat TTS
component.summary: Reads YouTube live chat aloud and mixes the speech into OBS

description.p: YouTube Chat TTS adds a dock to OBS Studio that reads YouTube live chat messages aloud using the bundled espeak-ng offline speech engine and feeds the synthesized speech into OBS as a native audio source, so streams and recordings carry spoken chat like any other audio.
This release is the initial Flatpak extension skeleton: the module installs into OBS Studio and shows the placeholder YouTube Chat TTS dock.
Initial extension skeleton with the YouTube Chat TTS dock.
